source_map.summary: Product Vision GBrain Atlas Context System (VIS-001..011).
Product Canvas GBrain Atlas Context System (CAN-001..014).
PRD GBrain Atlas Context System (REQ-001..008, AC-001..024, NFR-001..005, RISK-001..006).

product_vision_statement.value: Lokal deploybares GBrain-System, das beliebige Daten in ueberpruefbaren Goldstandard-Markdown ueberfuehrt, semantisch/ontologisch verknuepft und ueber MCP als verlaesslichen Agentenkontext bereitstellt; Atlas als 3D-Graph-/Review-Oberflaeche.

target_group.value: Systemarchitekt / Power-User; initial Ben als Builder und erster Operator; spaeter berechtigte Mitarbeitende an einem GBrain-System.

product_value.value: Heterogene Daten werden zu einheitlichem Goldstandard-Markdown, im GBrain semantisch/ontologisch verknuepft, Luecken werden sichtbar, Kontext wird ueber MCP fuer Agenten nutzbar.

success_signals.value: MCP HTTP Smoke laeuft reproduzierbar lokal.
Ein Markdown-Datensatz wird validiert, in GBrain geschrieben, erzeugt Graphverknuepfungen und macht mindestens eine semantische/ontologische Luecke sichtbar.

problem.value: Wissens-/Projektdaten liegen fragmentiert in heterogenen Formaten vor; ohne Standardisierung, semantische Verknuepfung und MCP-Schnittstelle erhalten Agenten unvollstaendigen, nicht nachvollziehbaren Kontext.

value_promise.value: Verwandelt heterogene Daten in Goldstandard-Markdown, speichert im GBrain, verknuepft semantisch/ontologisch, macht Luecken sichtbar und stellt Kontext ueber MCP bereit; Atlas macht den Wissensraum 3D-sichtbar.

success_signal.value: Harter Erfolg: MCP HTTP Smoke reproduzierbar lokal. Produktwert: Markdown validiert, in GBrain gespeichert, verknuepft, erzeugt sichtbare Kontextluecke.

allowed_scope.value: Markdown-Input, Goldstandard-Validierung, Import, semantische/ontologische Verknuepfung, Luecken-Sichtbarkeit, MCP HTTP Smoke, Atlas-kompatibler Graph-Export, kontrollierter Write/Preview in eigene Source.

gap_criteria.value: GAP-C1 node without typed edge; GAP-C2 edge without provenance; GAP-C3 confidence below cutoff (default 0.5); GAP-C4 orphaned mandatory relation.

objective.value: Lokal deploybares GBrain-Kontextsystem: Markdown -> Goldstandard-Validierung -> kontrollierter GBrain-Write -> semantische/ontologische Verknuepfung -> MCP-Exposition -> Atlas-3D-Graph/Gaps.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a Markdown file, when ingest runs, then the file is parsed without destroying original content.
Given missing metadata, when validation runs, then missing fields are reported.
Given valid Markdown, when intake completes, then a normalized Goldstandard candidate is produced.
Given a Goldstandard candidate, when validation runs, then frontmatter, slug, title, type and relations are checked.
Given invalid metadata, when validation fails, then structured errors are returned.
Given valid Markdown, when validation passes, then the artifact is eligible for controlled write.
Given a valid Goldstandard page, when write is requested, then the page is written only into the configured source.
Given dry-run mode, when write is requested, then no persistent write occurs and a preview is returned.
Given a completed write, when audit data is inspected, then source, slug, timestamp and result are visible.
Given imported pages, when linking runs, then candidate nodes and edges are generated.
Given a generated relation, when inspected, then relation type and provenance are available or marked unknown.
Given weak/missing relation evidence, when graph analysis runs, then a gap is surfaced.
Given imported pages with missing relations, when gap detection runs, then unlinked/weakly-linked nodes are reported.
Given a graph export, when Atlas renders it, then gap nodes/indicators are visible.
Given a user inspects a gap, when details are requested, then missing evidence/relation is explained.
Given a local environment, when GBrain MCP HTTP server starts, then the endpoint is reachable.
Given an MCP HTTP request, when the smoke test runs, then an MCP-compatible response is returned.
Given the smoke test completes, when logs are inspected, then pass/fail is clear and reproducible.
Given a GBrain source, when graph export runs, then nodes and edges are emitted with stable IDs.
Given exported graph data, when Atlas loads it, then the graph renders without Atlas recreating GBrain semantics.
Given a graph edge/node, when inspected in Atlas, then provenance or gap status is available.
Given a non-Markdown file, when the future conversion skill runs, then a Goldstandard Markdown candidate is produced.
Given a generated candidate, when validation runs, then it follows the same rules as native Markdown.
Given unsupported content, when conversion fails, then the failure is explicit and no invalid data is written.

rows.evidence_needed: Ingest run log on a sample Markdown file showing non-destructive parse + Goldstandard candidate.
Validation report on valid + invalid fixtures (structured errors).
Generated node/edge set with relation type + provenance markers.
Gap-detection output naming >=1 unlinked/weak node + Atlas gap indicator.
Reproducible MCP HTTP smoke transcript with pass/fail log.
Graph export sample + Atlas render screenshot with stable IDs.
Deferred (post-MVP). Conversion-skill candidate output once built.

Keine Evidence-Artefakte (EV-###) definiert; alle TRC-Zeilen stehen auf 'missing-evidence'. Verhindert READY_FOR_AGILETEAM_PLANNING.
Quell-Traceability (SRC-004) hat zerstoerte Tabellen-Spaltentrenner; Inhalte rekonstruiert, Evidence/Source-Type-Spalten ergaenzt.
RESOLVED: Gap-Kriterien GAP-C1..GAP-C4 (Knoten ohne typisierte Kante, Kante ohne Provenance, Konfidenz < 0.5, verwaiste Pflicht-Relation) in REQ-005 definiert.

RESOLVED: Nutzer hat im aktuellen Kontext explizit bestaetigt (2026-06-21); Readiness -> READY_FOR_AGILETEAM_PLANNING. F-002 (AC-009 gap) + OQ-002 (deferred evidence) bleiben als bekannte Planning-Inputs offen.

RESOLVED (test-evidence): 'gbrain put --dry-run' schrieb real (AC-008-Verletzung). Root cause: parseOpArgs verwarf den globalen --dry-run-Flag, weil put_page (und ~16 ctx.dryRun-Ops) keinen dry_run-Param deklarieren; ctx.dryRun blieb false. Fix in src/cli.ts (dry_run als globaler Boolean) + test/cli-args.test.ts. Verifiziert: Dry-run liefert {dry_run:true}, kein Write.

VERIFIED (test-evidence): Realer Write von atlas-isolation-probe in gbrain-atlas-context ist dort abrufbar, aber page_not_found in --source default und in der Cross-Source-Standardsuche (isoliert/non-federated). Probe danach soft-deleted.

GAP (test-evidence): AC-009 (Audit-Record mit source+slug+timestamp+result) ist nicht erfuellbar — Felder existieren nur verstreut (put-result, list), kein konsolidierter Audit-Record; history leer; kein audit-op; write_through uebersprungen (DB-only source ohne local_path). Feature-Bedarf, nicht durch Test schliessbar.

user_confirmation.confirmation_phrase: Ich bestaetige, dass Product Canvas und Product Vision meine Absicht korrekt wiedergeben und als Grundlage fuer AgileTeam Planning verwendet werden duerfen.
